name: pendulum-swing
description: Content hangs from a fixed pivot and swings into rest with gravity-damped oscillation, like a hanging sign settling on its hook.

vars.description: Where the content hangs from. The swing rotates about this point, so the top edge stays pinned.
How far the first swing reaches before it settles. Every later swing scales with it, so the pendulum still comes to rest upright.
Which side the pendulum swings in from: right lifts the first swing clockwise, left mirrors it.
Content colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
